beats.intent: ThinkSR carries dense image features through four stages while a shared DQ-CTM thought process recurs on itself.
beats.claim: ThinkSR end to end: encoder, windows, shared DQ-CTM ticks, decoder.
beats.narration: The method keeps a dense carrier while letting compact thought update it. The encoder starts from the low-resolution image. Windowing partitions the dense field without dropping tokens. DQ-CTM applies shared parameters at each tick. The decoder turns the updated carrier back into the high-resolution output. Recurrence stays inside the thought process, so the whole image pipeline is not repeated.

params.headline: ThinkSR recurs inside the thought stage, not around the whole pipeline
params.note: The dense carrier is read and updated by compact thought.

beats.intent: The carrier equation first builds a dense feature field, then partitions that field into windows while retaining every token.
beats.narration: The carrier is the dense state that the compact thought process reads and updates. The encoder maps the low-resolution image into the feature field. The window partition operates on that field and keeps the tokens available to the model.

params.headline: The dense carrier is encoded first, then partitioned into windows

terms.label: encoder that turns the low-resolution image into features
window partition that keeps every token

beats.intent: DQ-CTM-SR is not the smallest model in the benchmark; its 1.129 million parameters are second largest among the five methods.
beats.claim: Table 1 reports Params for CARN, IMDN, RFDN, CATANet, and DQ-CTM-SR.
beats.narration: The parameter comparison makes the cost clear instead of treating compact thought as a small model. CATANet is the smallest reported method. RFDN is only slightly larger. IMDN sits between the compact CNN baselines and DQ-CTM-SR. DQ-CTM-SR has one point one two nine million parameters, the second largest count here. CARN is the largest of the five methods.

params.headline: DQ-CTM-SR is second largest by parameter count in this table
